content:
Done. Summary:

**Verification:** There were two records sharing report_number "EXP-413432" — id 136 (category="software", employee_id=10, status="approved") and id 700 (category="software-B", employee_id=10, status="approved"). Only id 136 exactly matches category "software".

**Procedure check:** Two versions of the handling procedure exist:
- Doc #9 (SUPERSEDED, 2025): approved → submitted
- Doc #10 (**CURRENT**, effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior): approved → reimbursed if employee_id = 10, otherwise → submitted

Record 136 has employee_id = 10, so per the current procedure the correct transition is approved → **reimbursed**.

**Action taken:** Updated finance_expense_reports id 136 (EXP-413432, category "software") status from "approved" to "reimbursed". No other fields were changed, and record id 700 (category "software-B") was left untouched since it did not match the exact category criterion.
